data.title: KBRA Assigns AA- Rating with Stable Outlook to Rio Rancho Public School District No. 94, NM General Obligation School Bonds Series 2026
data.description: In New York, KBRA has assigned a AA- long-term rating to Rio Rancho Public School District No. 94's General Obligation School Bonds, Series 2026. Additionally, KBRA rated outstanding parity debt at AA-. The Outlook for both ratings is Stable. The assignment was based on the following factors: a growing tax base and positive economic profile, as well as robust State oversight in the budgetary process.

data.title: FDA approves Pharming’s Joenja® as first treatment for children with APDS in the U.S.
data.description: Today, Pharming revealed that the U.S. FDA has given the green light to its supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) for Joenja® as the primary therapy for youngsters with Activating PI3K Delta Syndrome (APDS). This approval marks a significant milestone in providing a novel treatment option for children with this condition.

data.title: KBRA Assigns Preliminary Ratings to HS Issuer, LLC, Series 2026-1/2/3
data.description: In New York, credit rating agency KBRA has assigned preliminary ratings to HS Issuer, LLC, Series 2026-1/2/3 (HS 2026-1/2/3) for a service contract securitization mainly backed by home infrastructure plan agreements. This marks the first securitization for HS Issuer, LLC, operating as the Master Issuer. The transaction, structured as a master trust, allows for the potential issuance of more classes and series of notes under specific conditions.

data.title: Elastic Introduces Serverless Vector Database: Ship in Minutes, Scale Affordably to Hundreds of Billions of Vectors
data.description: In San Francisco, Elastic (NYSE: ESTC) introduced the Elasticsearch Vector Database, a serverless service designed for extensive vector search and AI tasks. Elasticsearch is renowned for vector workloads globally and this new offering provides developers with an expertly configured database to swiftly create top-notch vector search applications. By bringing their documents and queries, developers can leverage Elastic's optimized database, streamlining the process for large-scale vector tasks.

data.title: Why Oracle's 'Solid' Results Aren't Giving Its Stock A Big Boost
data.description: Despite a significant increase in revenue driven by high demand for its AI cloud services, Oracle's stock remains unchanged. The company's financial results were described as "solid," with a notable rise in revenue. This increase in revenue was primarily fueled by the strong demand for Oracle's AI cloud offering. However, this positive performance did not result in a significant boost in the company's stock value.

data.title: Hot CPI Inflation Seals Fed Rate Hike, But Stocks Rise
data.description: In August, the consumer price index indicated a higher-than-anticipated increase in core CPI, possibly leading to a Federal Reserve interest rate hike on September 16. Despite this news, S&P 500 futures experienced a rise in value. This highlights the impact of hot CPI inflation on the financial market, potentially influencing investor reactions and overall market trends.
